data.name: AboutUs_Story_Title
data.value: Elevating the legacy of collectible history

data.name: AboutUs_Story_P1
data.value: CardMarket is the trusted home for graded TCG, sports cards, and premium collectibles. We combine heritage auction expertise with modern verification so every listing is transparent, secure, and ready for serious collectors.

data.name: AboutUs_Story_P2
data.value: From PSA slabs to vintage sports legends, our marketplace is built around authenticity first — rigorous verification, transparent pricing, and a community that values provenance as much as price.

data.name: AboutUs_Story_P3
data.value: Whether you are bidding live, buying now, or consigning a grail card, CardMarket gives you live auction updates, verified seller profiles, and secure checkout in one place.

data.name: AboutUs_Mission_Desc
data.value: We believe that every card tells a story. Our mission is to preserve these stories through a platform built on absolute transparency, expert curation, and technological precision — with industry standards like PSA and BGS authentication at the core.

data.name: AboutUs_Mission_Integrity_Desc
data.value: Every listing is vetted against the highest global standards for authenticity through a multi-step verification process.

data.name: AboutUs_Mission_Custodians_Desc
data.value: We track ownership history and provenance for high-value assets across our ecosystem.

data.name: AboutUs_Mission_CardAlt
data.value: Graded Mickey Mantle baseball card in PSA slab

data.name: AboutUs_TrustGrading_Desc
data.value: Strategic partnerships with PSA and BGS ensure every card on CardMarket is exactly what it claims to be.

data.name: AboutUs_TrustGrading_PsaDesc
data.value: Direct integration allows real-time verification of PSA slabs in our inventory — no manual entry, no human error.

data.name: AboutUs_TrustGrading_MultiDesc
data.value: Our specialists perform a secondary physical inspection on every high-tier asset before listing.

data.name: AboutUs_TrustGrading_BgsDesc
data.value: Specialized partnership focusing on centering, corners, edges, and surface preservation.

data.name: AboutUs_TrustGrading_VaultDesc
data.value: Climate-controlled facilities preserve your assets in museum-grade conditions until the moment of sale.

data.name: AboutUs_Team_Desc
data.value: Our team brings over 30 years of combined experience in the global collectibles market.

data.name: AboutUs_Team_Member1_Bio
data.value: Leads product vision and marketplace strategy for CardMarket. Phạm Việt Anh connects collectors with trusted high-value listings.

data.name: AboutUs_Team_Member2_Bio
data.value: Oversees listing quality and collectible authenticity standards. Danil Fomin Long ensures every card meets vault-grade criteria.

data.name: AboutUs_Team_Member3_Bio
data.value: Owns platform architecture and auction reliability. Nguyễn Văn Hưng keeps bidding, payments, and verification running smoothly.

data.name: AboutUs_Team_Member4_Bio
data.value: Coordinates seller onboarding and live auction operations. Đinh Văn Hải keeps the marketplace moving day to day.

data.name: AboutUs_Team_Member5_Bio
data.value: Focuses on fraud prevention and listing verification. Nguyễn Hữu Quân protects buyers and sellers across every deal.

data.name: AboutUs_Team_Member6_Bio
data.value: Builds collector community and go-to-market programs. Nguyễn Giang Hà helps new sellers and bidders succeed on CardMarket.
